entries.summary: Created sample Python tutorial videos, fixed streaming proxy, added VideoPlayerPage for React app with Watch Video button in course detail.
entries.details: Created 11 sample videos for Python for Beginners course. Updated views_video_stream.py to serve local files. Added VideoPlayerPage.jsx with full video player, chapters list, progress bar. Added 'Watch Video' button in CourseDetail.jsx for lessons with videos. Added has_video field to LessonPublicSerializer.
entries.code:
Route: /lessons/:id/video → VideoPlayerPage

# CourseDetail.jsx
{lesson.has_video && (
  <Link to={`/lessons/${lesson.id}/video`} className="video-link">
    ▶ Watch Video
  </Link>
)}

# VideoPlayerPage.jsx
- Full video player with controls
- Chapters sidebar
- Auto-play next segment
- Preload indicator
- Buffering indicator
decisions: Each course gets its own repo: aura-course-{course-slug}
Each lesson is a folder: lesson-{id}-{title}
User can override segment_duration via API (30-3600 seconds)
YouTube-like player with auto-play, progress bar, chapters sidebar
Streaming proxy fetches from GitHub on-demand, no local storage
Loading indicator shows when fetching from GitHub
Preload next segment 10 seconds before current ends
Questions appear at specific timestamps, video pauses
AI agent explains wrong answers with retry option
Streaming proxy serves local files when no GitHub connected
Added routes for course detail and lesson view
Added CSS for course detail and lesson pages
